title: Quasinormal modes and AdS/CFT correspondence of a rotating BTZ-like black hole in the Einstein-bumblebee gravity
summary: We obtain exact expressions for the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of the massive scalar, fermionic and vector perturbations around a rotating BTZ-like black hole in the Einstein-bumblebee gravity. We find that the Lorentz symmetry breaking (LSB) parameter $\ell$ leaves its imprint only on the imaginary parts of the quasinormal frequencies and the corresponding perturbation field decays more slowly for a larger $\ell$, except for the left-moving quasinormal frequencies $ω_L$ with positive mass and the right-moving ones $ω_R$ with negative mass for the fundamental modes under the vector…
